title: Preserve unknown provenance when restoring legacy context
summary: A value restored by normalization or a migration does not establish what the original caller supplied; lossy execution projections cannot reconstruct execution choices.
reusable_steps: A value restored by normalization or a migration does not establish what the original caller supplied; lossy execution projections cannot reconstruct execution choices
expected_outcome: When adding context provenance, store it with new records and preserve known origins on unchanged updates. Legacy migrations must copy only known provenance and leave restored defaults unknown. Test a real old-format ledger record, not only records produced by the new facade. Keep descriptive provenance separate from authorization and entity-existence checks. For intent display, prefer canonical execution_shape; a legacy many-to-one task_session projection cannot prove a Task Session record exists. Validate creation, updates, migration, idempotent replay and displayed labels together.
